name: Whispers of Dawn
title: Every Sunrise Brings Hope
author: Emily Carter
description: A short inspirational poem about hope.
poem:
When dawn awakes with golden light,
It paints the world so warm and bright.
The silent breeze begins to sing,
And hope returns on gentle wings.

name: Moonlight Dreams
title: The Silent Night
author: John Walker
description: A peaceful poem about the moon.
poem:
Beneath the moon so calm and bright,
The stars awake throughout the night.
Dreams take flight without a sound,
Where endless peace is always found.

name: Believe
title: Never Give Up
author: Sophia Green
poem:
Stand again when you fall low,
Plant the seeds and watch them grow.
Every dream begins today,
If you never walk away.
